author: Tim Rehahn
text:
They were great, we adopted a bonded pair, made the process extremely easy for us.  They're doing great work for the animals.  I have supported them since, we'll continue to support them.  I encourage others to do the same.

Update they're still great! I adopted another from them.  They've been great through it all.

author: Jeremy Somers
text:
I’ve had a great experience with the Humane Society of Monroe County. The staff is clearly dedicated to the well-being of the animals, and you can see the care and effort that goes into keeping them safe, healthy, and ready for adoption.
The facility is clean, organized, and welcoming, and the team does a great job helping match animals with the right homes. It’s clear they truly care about both the animals and the community.
I would absolutely recommend stopping in if you’re considering adopting or looking to support a local organization doing meaningful work.

author: Robert Williams
text: Really good to go and volunteer walking dogs on Saturday,  especially after having to put mine down recently.  Plus it's a big help for the people working there. Most of the dogs are super sweet they are just scared. a little bit freaked out which i can understand so I take my time with them and listen to the staff instructions.  It's beneficial for all me, staff, and the dogs.

author: William DeJesus
text: It's been one month since we adopted "Patches" and I'd like to say that she has been very loved ever since! Ever since the lady at the front gave me that story on her, I knew I had to be the one to give Patches the love and care she deserved! Absolutely amazing place, they care about the animals deeply

author: Zachary White
text: We adopted an absolute sweetheart from this facility.  The staff is kind and knowledgeable.  They truly care about their animals.
